approach: Find the apparent frequency for an observer approaching a stationary source, then take the fractional rise over the true frequency as a percentage.

steps.text: Write the Doppler formula for a moving observer and a stationary source, with the observer's speed one-fifth of the speed of sound.
Find the increase in frequency over the true frequency f.
Express this increase as a percentage of f.

common_mistakes.text: Reporting the ratio 16.67%, which is the fractional rise measured against the apparent frequency f' instead of against the true frequency f.
